rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold a 7-Justice coalition together around a narrow, administrable reaffirmation of Melendez-Diaz/Bullcoming that rejects “basis-only” end-runs while preserving room for machine-generated data and genuinely independent expert opinions. Thomas is likely to write separately to emphasize original meaning/formality, and the two dissenters are likely to split between an administrability-focused dissent (Alito) and a “conduit-only” limiting dissent (Kavanaugh).
